snippet.title: Mischief Mandarin - Game Trailer (Steam/PC)
snippet.description:
Step into a lighthearted adventure where wit beats power and laughter is the best revenge. Play as a brave kid who pulls ingenious pranks on an arrogant mandarin to stand up for bullied friends and villagers. Enjoy a game packed with clever tricks, playful challenges, and nonstop fun!

Play the free demo on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4160340/MISCHIEF_MANDARIN/?beta=0
